newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: PRESS DIGEST - Macedonia - March 14. [CORRECTED 12:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Macedonia - March 14. [CORRECTED 12:00 GMT]

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The incident that happend on the Kjafasan border crossing with Albania on Thursday reason for closing of all border crossings with this country. Macedonian police opened fire on serveral Albanian policemen who attempted illegal entry into Macedonia.

- Stable inter-ethnic relations are the foundations for a Macedonian state the Macedonian Parliament concluded at its session Thursday. Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski said the government would continue with politics of tolerance and building of inter-ethnic confidence in Macedonia. Although invited, leaders of opposition parties did not attend.

- Deputy governor (corrects title from Vice-governor) of the Macedonian National Bank Tome Nenovski arrested as well as one official of the national bank (corrects from "several other officials") and one of the Bitola pyramid savings bank TAT.
- The value of the German mark in Bitola went up to 30 denars for one mark from 27.
- Macedonian finance minister Taki Fiti stated Thursday the ministry expects final information on the scandal with TAT bank from Bitola in order to issue an official statement on the issue.
